d:
Enjoy this full video song "Abhi Abhi" from one of the most anticipated album "Jism 2". The song starts with the strumming guitars and piano melody that hooks you in and the magical voice of KK makes it even more likable.
Song: Abhi Abhi
Movie: Jism 2
Starcast: Sunny Leone, Arunnoday Singh, Randeep Hooda
Singer: K.K
Composed By: Arko Pravo Mukherjee
Lyricist: Arko Pravo Mukherjee and Munish Makhija
Music Label: T-Series
